adenylate cyclases in the testes are distributed on the plasma membranes of spermatogonia, early and elongated spermatid, Sertoli cells in the seminiferious tubules, and Leydig cells in the interstitial spaces.

adenylate cyclases in the guinea pig testes are localized in the basal compartment of seminiferous tubule, on the basal plasma membrane of Sertoli and spermatogonia and in the adlumina compartment, on the spermatids plasma membrane.
adenylate cyclases of guinea pig testes are located on the plasma membranes of Sertoil cells, spermatogonia, spermatocytes, spermatids and Leydig cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the distribution of adenine nucleotide cyclase in the guinea pig testes.
the localization of adenylate‐cyclase reaction product on Sertoli and spermatid plasma membrane.
the cytochemical localization of adenylate cylase, the enzyme responsible for the formation of the second messenger, cyclic AMP.

adenylate cyclases are associated with the basal and adluminal compartments, but that they are more prominent in the adlumina1 compartment, and that adenylate cydase activity in the basal compartment is more sensitive to inhibition by the cytochemical medium.

adenylate cyclases are localized in testis on the basal surface and the adluminal plasma membranes of Sartoli cells, the basal surface of spermatogonia, and the adlumial plasma membrane of early and elongated spermatides.

adenylate cyclases in the seminiferou s epithelium are associated with the plasma membrane of Sertoli cell and spermatogonia at the level of basal compartment, and with Sertoli cell plasma membranes and early spermatids plasma membranes at the adluminal level.

adenylate cyclases in the guinea pig testes are distributed on the plasma membranes of spermatogonias, Sertoli and spermatid cells.
adenylate cyclases are present on the plasma membrane of Sertoli, spermatogon, and spermatid cells.

the adenylate cyclases in guinea pig spermatids and Sertoli cells are different, and that the adenylates in the basal and the adluminal compartments of the seminifierous epithelium are different.
